---
title: "project"
---

Use the `project` command for shared project/operator tooling that is independent of agent configuration.

## Install or update `pj`

```bash
setupmjr project --pj
```

This installs `pj` from the canonical `MiguelRodo/pj` repository by shallow-cloning the floating `v0` tag and running its installer. The `v0` tag advances with compatible versioned `pj` releases, so this path follows the released v0 line rather than `pj/main`.

`setupmjr` does not own or vendor the `pj` implementation. It only installs the release selected by `pj`'s own floating release tag.

## Install the GitHub Projects skill

```bash
setupmjr project --gh-skill
```

This installs `github-projects` from `MiguelRodo/github-projects-skill` for universal agents at user scope. It is equivalent to:

```bash
gh skill install MiguelRodo/github-projects-skill github-projects --agent universal --scope user --force --pin main
```

The command installs the shared skill only. Repository-specific Project onboarding and `.projects` configuration remain separate concerns.

Both pieces may be installed or refreshed in one command:

```bash
setupmjr project --pj --gh-skill
```
